en: Ask about your cases from WhatsApp. You can disconnect it any time.
What you bought, with an invoice and receipts you can download.
When you buy a plan, its invoice and receipt appear here. Nothing is charged without you paying for it.
You can ask for a full refund until {formatBillingDateTime} (Bangladesh time), and you do not need to give a reason. The period it paid for ends once the refund is made.

Everything in VisaStack stays free during the beta. A paid plan gives you more room: more storage and higher daily limits, for you and everyone you keep a record for. It is paid in advance and never charges you again by itself.
No automatic charge. We remind you before it ends, and you decide then whether to pay again.
Traveller Free and the Paid Plans Side by Side

Only bookings, itineraries, invitations and accommodation papers can be shared across a trip. Passports, bank papers and medical papers never are.

Anyone who has this link can see these dates, their general titles such as "Task Due", and the traveller's first name, which names the calendar. It never shows full names, case names, documents or notes. Keep it private. If someone else may have it, make a new link or stop sharing.
Then add it to your calendar app:
Adds the case name after the title, for example "Task Due - Japan Visit". Anyone who can see your calendar will see it. A case name with a number, a link or an email address in it is left out.
Dates without a time are added as all-day events. Titles are general, such as "Task Due", unless you choose to add case names. Dates more than {CALENDAR_PAST_DAYS} days ago are not listed.
One file holds up to {CALENDAR_EXPORT_LIMIT} events, so the last {plural} you chose {choice} left out. Download them in a second file.
